content.short: Ghost builds GhostGraph, an indexing framework for writing custom on-chain data transforms.
content.description: Ghost builds two developer products for on-chain data. GhostGraph lets a team define custom indexers for specific contracts in place of a generic schema, integrating directly with existing Solidity projects. GhostLogs exposes contract-level logging across multiple smart contract languages and feeds into common analytics tools. Both support a broad set of networks, Monad among them.
